principles: Only fix real Research M0 readiness correctness, not cosmetic completeness.
Keep host-neutral boundaries: Codex/Claude/agy are hosts, not proof of model family.
Prefer explicit blocker states over silent overclaiming.
Do not let research artifacts mutate product gates, playbooks, DONE policy, or runtime guidance.
drivers: The user asked to execute Research M0 but selected text explicitly says not to run large Phase 1.
Provider model snapshots and real cells are costly and temporally unstable, so M0 must separate readiness from outcome production.
Lattice story scope excludes unrelated dirty files and product runtime changes.

options.name: offline-m0-artifacts-and-checker
pros: Keeps provider calls and Phase 1/2 cells out of scope
Can record blockers without faking results
cons: Does not produce H-M1/H-M3 outcome data
Dated provider snapshot readiness may remain a Phase 1 blocker

options.name: start-small-provider-cell-run-now
pros: Would test actual model adapters earlier
cons: Violates current no-Phase-1 boundary unless separately approved
Risks counting under-specified smoke output as research outcome
Costs money/time before budget-lock and runner registry are proven

options.name: docs-only-status-update
cons: Would repeat the prior problem of plan prose without a mechanical check

rationale: A provider-safe artifact set plus checker is the smallest real execution of Research M0: it verifies fairness mechanics and launch blockers without optimizing arbitrarily or overclaiming paper results.

preMortem.scenario: Host identity is mistaken for model identity
preMortem.trigger: A runner records Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI as the model snapshot
preMortem.consequence: The experiment could falsely claim multi-model evidence from a host-only difference
preMortem.mitigation: Checker rejects hostKind matching executorSnapshot or reviewerSnapshot and requires E1/E2 provider family separation.

preMortem.trigger: A2prime rows run or validate without a frozen budgetLockDigest derived from ③ calibration
preMortem.consequence: The A2prime control becomes post-hoc and cannot support Q1
preMortem.mitigation: Checker requires each A2prime row to bind exactly one frozen budget lock and verifies source ③ precedes applies-to ⑥.

preMortem.scenario: Illegal ② vs ④ comparison enters confirmatory analysis
preMortem.trigger: Analysis contrast metadata treats cross cells as directly comparable
preMortem.consequence: Executor and reviewer effects are confounded
preMortem.mitigation: Checker encodes allowed confirmatory contrasts and explicitly rejects ② vs ④ as confirmatory.

preMortem.scenario: M0 is misread as completed Phase 1
preMortem.trigger: Status or summary says outcome records exist from smoke checks
preMortem.consequence: Research claims overstate evidence and could pollute product decisions
preMortem.mitigation: Artifacts state providerCallsMade=false, containsOutcomeData=false, phase1OrPhase2CellsRun=false, and productGateImpact=none.
